slides.heading: Zigzag Traverse
slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Hard · Arrays
slides.narration: Let's solve Zigzag Traverse, a hard arrays problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: Read a matrix along anti-diagonals in zigzag, starting at top-left and moving down first (odd diagonals are read bottom-to-top, even ones top-to-bottom).
slides.narration: Here's the problem. Read a matrix along anti-diagonals in zigzag, starting at top-left and moving down first (odd diagonals are read bottom-to-top, even ones top-to-bottom).

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: Walk diagonals, bouncing off the edges and flipping direction each time.
slides.narration: Walk diagonals, bouncing off the edges and flipping direction each time.

slides.heading: Approach
bullets: 3. At an edge, step along it and flip direction
slides.narration: Step by step. First, start at top-left heading down. Second, move diagonally. Third, at an edge, step along it and flip direction. Fourth, stop after every cell.
